## Executive Summary

Not applicable. Falcon is an infrastructure/telemetry repository with no Supabase project, no SQL schema, no migrations, and no RLS policies. The datastore is OpenSearch with the security plugin; its equivalent controls are per-service least-privilege identities and TLS, declared in `bootstrap/60-central-deploy.sh` and live-verified (no DLS/FLS by design — single tenant). The only Postgres in scope is the vendored DFIR-IRIS case-management app, which is third-party software outside this repository's authored surface. No findings.

## Detailed Review

### Item: Equivalent control — OpenSearch security plugin

- Evidence: `bootstrap/60-central-deploy.sh:131-202`; live `_plugins/_security/api/roles`.
- What it does: `falcon_writer` can `create_index`/`write`/`read`/`view_index_metadata`/`indices:admin/mapping/put` on `falcon-*`; `falcon_reader` (dashboard, healthcheck) read-only plus alias-get; `falcon_backup` snapshot/repository only; admin is break-glass; demo users deleted.
- Missing controls: no document-level or field-level security, no per-tenant policy — acceptable for a single-tenant lab; a future multi-tenant deployment would need the OpenSearch DLS/FLS equivalent of RLS.
- Recommended improvement: record the "single tenant; no DLS/FLS by design" decision in the security docs so a future multi-tenant evolution starts from an explicit statement.

### Item: Vendored IRIS Postgres

- Evidence: `mct/compose/docker-compose.dfir-iris.yml`, `compose/mct/iris-web/docker-compose.base.yml`.
- What it does: third-party case-management app with its own Postgres; not authored or migrated by this repository. No RLS review applicable; access is service-level (IRIS app roles), not row-level in this repository's scope.
